#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fill ConfigHub with this Argo CD estate: one base per component, one
# variant per cluster, one Target per cluster. Written by `cub argo apply`.
# Read it, then run it:
#
#   bash apply.sh
#
# Nothing here touches a cluster. Argo goes on syncing Git throughout, and
# ConfigHub ends up holding a parallel copy that nothing reads. handover.sh
# is what moves the estate onto it; until you run that, nothing on any
# cluster reads what this creates, and cleanup.sh beside this script takes
# it all back out. ConfigHub refuses a Space while a Target, a worker, a
# Release or a Tag still points at it, so the order matters and that
# script has it.
#
# cub uses its current context; set CUB_CONTEXT to choose another. Every
# step is safe to re-run, which is also how a cluster that joined since
# gets its variants.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
step() { printf '\n== %s\n' "$*"; }
# The overlays are rendered from the repository this plan read. Paths below
# are written from its top, so the script needs to know where that is.
REPO_ROOT=${REPO_ROOT:-'<repo>'}
[ -d "$REPO_ROOT" ] || { echo "REPO_ROOT=$REPO_ROOT is not a directory: point it at the repository checkout"; exit 1; }

# Re-running picks up where ConfigHub says each first release stands: a
# finished change order is skipped, and a variant with nothing new is kept.
rolled_out() { [ "$(cub changeorder get --space "${1%/*}" "${1#*/}" -o jq=.ChangeOrder.Stage)" = Completed ]; }
# A variant must hold every unit of its base before it is released: a
# reconciler removes from a cluster whatever a release no longer holds.
holds() {
  local n; n=$(cub unit list --space "$1" -o jq=length)
  [ "$n" -ge "$2" ] || { echo "$1 holds $n of its $2 units; run this script again" >&2; return 1; }
}
# A cluster that joins in a stage the workflow does not have yet adds that
# stage. Only the stages are patched, so approval settings made since stay.
stages_are() { [ "$(cub changeworkflow get --space "$1" "$2" -o 'jq=[.ChangeWorkflow.Stages[].Name] | join(",")')" = "$3" ]; }
# Promoting a large unit can outlast the request, and cub then reports no
# response while the server finishes. A promotion is idempotent, so it is
# asked again, and one with nothing left to promote has done it.
promote() {
  local out
  for _ in 1 2 3; do
    out=$(cub variant promote --change-order "$1" --target-stage "$2" --quiet 2>&1 >/dev/null) && return 0
    case "$out" in *"nothing left to promote"*) return 0 ;; esac
    sleep 15
  done
  echo "$out" >&2; return 1
}
publish() {
  local out
  holds "$1" "$3" || return 1
  out=$(cub release publish "$1" --revision "ChangeOrder:$2" --quiet 2>&1) && return 0
  case "$out" in *"no changes were made since :latest bundle"*) echo "$1 already released" ;; *) echo "$out" >&2; return 1 ;; esac
}
# Each source is rendered by kustomize here rather than by the plugin, so
# what ConfigHub stores is exactly what the delivery tool builds today.
build() {
  if [ -e "$1/kustomization.yaml" ] || [ -e "$1/kustomization.yml" ] || [ -e "$1/Kustomization" ]; then
    kustomize build ${KUSTOMIZE_FLAGS:-} "$1"; return
  fi
  local k dir rc=0 depth="-maxdepth 1"
  [ "${2:-}" = recurse ] && depth=""
  dir=$(cd "$1" && pwd) || return 1
  k=$(mktemp -d)
  { echo "resources:"
    (cd "$dir" && find . $depth -type f \( -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.json' \) -not -path '*/.*') \
      | LC_ALL=C sort | sed "s|^\./|- $dir/|"; } > "$k/kustomization.yaml"
  kustomize build --load-restrictor LoadRestrictionsNone "$k" || rc=$?
  rm -rf "$k"; return $rc
}
# A variant cloned while its base held no unit holds none either, as after
# a first run that stopped part way. It gets a clone, linked to the base, so
# a change made on the base still reaches it.
has_unit() {
  cub unit get --space "$1" "$2" >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 0
  cub unit create --space "$1" "$2" --upstream-space "$3" --upstream-unit "$2" --target "$4" --quiet
}
render() {
  mkdir -p render
  build "$REPO_ROOT/$1" "${3:-}" > "render/$2.yaml"
  [ -s "render/$2.yaml" ] || { echo "$REPO_ROOT/$1 rendered nothing" >&2; return 1; }
}

step "0/5 Check before changing anything"
cub auth status >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "cub is not logged in: run cub auth login"; exit 1; }
cub auth status 2>&1 | grep -i '^Warning:' && echo "  Steps below may fail on that skew rather than on anything here."
command -v kustomize >/dev/null || { echo "kustomize is not on PATH; the overlays are rendered with it"; exit 1; }
# A component here inflates a Helm chart through Kustomize, which needs the
# same flag Argo CD's repo server is configured with.
KUSTOMIZE_FLAGS=${KUSTOMIZE_FLAGS:---enable-helm}

step "1/5 One named Target per cluster, in argo-targets"
cub space create argo-targets --allow-exists --quiet
# A server-hosted worker has no process behind it and no role in the
# organization; it is the credential Argo reads with. Its bot user holds View
# and ViewChildren on each Target, to find it and pull its Releases.
cub worker create --space argo-targets server-worker --is-server-worker --org-role none --allow-exists --quiet
bot_user="$(cub worker get --space argo-targets server-worker -o jq=.BridgeWorker.UserID | tr -d '\n')"
# The cluster Argo CD itself runs on: the control objects are released here.
cub target create argocd --space argo-targets --permission "View:${bot_user}" --permission "ViewChildren:${bot_user}" --allow-exists --quiet
cub target create dev-1 --space argo-targets --permission "View:${bot_user}" --permission "ViewChildren:${bot_user}" --allow-exists --quiet
cub target create prod-1 --space argo-targets --permission "View:${bot_user}" --permission "ViewChildren:${bot_user}" --allow-exists --quiet
cub target create staging-1 --space argo-targets --permission "View:${bot_user}" --permission "ViewChildren:${bot_user}" --allow-exists --quiet

step "2/5 One Space per app of apps, holding the objects it syncs"
cub component create argo-root-children --allow-exists --quiet
cub space create argo-root-children --component argo-root-children --label Component=argo-root-children --label Role=control --allow-exists --quiet
cub unit create --space argo-root-children platform-addons-appset control/argo-root-children/platform-addons-appset.yaml --target argo-targets/argocd --change-desc 'Onboard platform-addons-appset: what the root app of apps syncs' --allow-exists --quiet
cub unit create --space argo-root-children projects control/argo-root-children/projects.yaml --target argo-targets/argocd --change-desc 'Onboard projects: what the root app of apps syncs' --allow-exists --quiet
cub unit create --space argo-root-children storefront-app-of-apps control/argo-root-children/storefront-app-of-apps.yaml --target argo-targets/argocd --change-desc 'Onboard storefront-app-of-apps: what the root app of apps syncs' --allow-exists --quiet
tid=$(cub target get --space argo-targets argocd -o jq=.Target.TargetID | tr -d '"')
[ -n "$tid" ] || { echo "no argocd Target in argo-targets: run step 1 first"; exit 1; }
echo "{\"ReleaseTargetID\":\"$tid\"}" | cub space update --patch argo-root-children --from-stdin --quiet
cub release publish argo-root-children --quiet 2>&1 | grep -v 'no changes were made' || true
cub component create argo-storefront-children --allow-exists --quiet
cub space create argo-storefront-children --component argo-storefront-children --label Component=argo-storefront-children --label Role=control --allow-exists --quiet
cub unit create --space argo-storefront-children apptique control/argo-storefront-children/apptique.yaml --target argo-targets/argocd --change-desc 'Onboard apptique: what the storefront app of apps syncs' --allow-exists --quiet
cub unit create --space argo-storefront-children checkout-cache control/argo-storefront-children/checkout-cache.yaml --target argo-targets/argocd --change-desc 'Onboard checkout-cache: what the storefront app of apps syncs' --allow-exists --quiet
tid=$(cub target get --space argo-targets argocd -o jq=.Target.TargetID | tr -d '"')
[ -n "$tid" ] || { echo "no argocd Target in argo-targets: run step 1 first"; exit 1; }
echo "{\"ReleaseTargetID\":\"$tid\"}" | cub space update --patch argo-storefront-children --from-stdin --quiet
cub release publish argo-storefront-children --quiet 2>&1 | grep -v 'no changes were made' || true

step "3/5 One component per app: a base holding what its overlay renders to, and a rollout workflow"
cub component create argo-apptique --allow-exists --quiet
cub space create argo-apptique-base --component argo-apptique --label Component=argo-apptique --label Role=base --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/apptique/base' 'apptique-base'
cub unit create --space argo-apptique-base apptique render/apptique-base.yaml --change-desc 'Onboard apptique from gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/apptique/base' --allow-exists --quiet
cub changeworkflow create --space argo-apptique-base rollout --filename apptique/change-workflow.yaml --allow-exists --quiet
stages_are argo-apptique-base rollout 'canary,secondary,primary' || echo '{"Stages":[{"Name":"canary","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''canary'\''","ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]},{"Name":"secondary","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''secondary'\''","Prerequisites":["Released"],"ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]},{"Name":"primary","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''primary'\''","Prerequisites":["Released"],"ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]}]}' | cub changeworkflow update --patch --space argo-apptique-base rollout --from-stdin --quiet
cub component create argo-checkout-cache --allow-exists --quiet
cub space create argo-checkout-cache-base --component argo-checkout-cache --label Component=argo-checkout-cache --label Role=base --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/checkout-cache/base' 'checkout-cache-base'
cub unit create --space argo-checkout-cache-base checkout-cache render/checkout-cache-base.yaml --change-desc 'Onboard checkout-cache from gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/checkout-cache/base' --allow-exists --quiet
cub changeworkflow create --space argo-checkout-cache-base rollout --filename checkout-cache/change-workflow.yaml --allow-exists --quiet
stages_are argo-checkout-cache-base rollout 'canary,secondary,primary' || echo '{"Stages":[{"Name":"canary","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''canary'\''","ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]},{"Name":"secondary","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''secondary'\''","Prerequisites":["Released"],"ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]},{"Name":"primary","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''primary'\''","Prerequisites":["Released"],"ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]}]}' | cub changeworkflow update --patch --space argo-checkout-cache-base rollout --from-stdin --quiet
cub component create argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline --allow-exists --quiet
cub space create argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-base --component argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline --label Component=argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline --label Role=base --allow-exists --quiet
render 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/platform/cluster-baseline/base' 'platform-addons-cluster-baseline-base'
cub unit create --space argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-base platform-addons-cluster-baseline render/platform-addons-cluster-baseline-base.yaml --change-desc 'Onboard platform-addons-cluster-baseline from gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/platform/cluster-baseline/base' --allow-exists --quiet
cub changeworkflow create --space argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-base rollout --filename platform-addons-cluster-baseline/change-workflow.yaml --allow-exists --quiet
stages_are argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-base rollout 'canary,secondary,primary' || echo '{"Stages":[{"Name":"canary","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''canary'\''","ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]},{"Name":"secondary","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''secondary'\''","Prerequisites":["Released"],"ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]},{"Name":"primary","WhereSpace":"Labels.Stage = '\''primary'\''","Prerequisites":["Released"],"ReleasePrerequisites":["approval"]}]}' | cub changeworkflow update --patch --space argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-base rollout --from-stdin --quiet

step "4/5 One variant per cluster, each holding what its overlay renders to"
# Each variant's Application is the one Argo CD runs already; after the
# handover, move-applications.sh makes it a Unit. So a cub that would add a
# second Application when it makes a variant for an Argo cluster is told not to.
no_argo_app=; case "$(cub variant create --help 2>&1)" in *--no-argo-app*) no_argo_app=--no-argo-app ;; esac
# Once handover.sh has begun, a variant with a release is ConfigHub's: changes
# to it are made there, through change orders, and re-rendering it from Git
# would publish Git over them. Measured: re-run for a joining cluster, that
# rolled every existing cluster back to Git. Before the handover Git is still
# what Argo applies, so every variant is rendered again, which is how a change
# in Git since the last run is picked up.
released() {
  local out; out=$(cub release get --space "$1" --oci-reference latest -o jq=.Release.ReleaseNum 2>&1) && return 0
  case "$out" in *"not found"*|*"no release"*|*"404"*) return 1 ;; esac
  echo "could not tell whether $1 has a release: $out" >&2; exit 1
}
handed_over() { [ -s handover-state/argo.txt ]; }
if handed_over && released argo-apptique-dev-1; then echo '  argo-apptique-dev-1 is released and handed over: ConfigHub holds it, so it is left as it is'; else
  cub variant create dev-1 argo-apptique-base --stage canary --space-pattern template:argo-apptique-dev-1 --target argo-targets/dev-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=dev-1 $no_argo_app --allow-exists --quiet
  render 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/apptique/overlays/dev' 'argo-apptique-dev-1'
  has_unit argo-apptique-dev-1 apptique argo-apptique-base argo-targets/dev-1
  cub unit update --space argo-apptique-dev-1 apptique render/argo-apptique-dev-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/apptique/overlays/dev renders for dev-1' --quiet
  holds argo-apptique-dev-1 1
fi
if handed_over && released argo-apptique-staging-1; then echo '  argo-apptique-staging-1 is released and handed over: ConfigHub holds it, so it is left as it is'; else
  cub variant create staging-1 argo-apptique-base --stage secondary --space-pattern template:argo-apptique-staging-1 --target argo-targets/staging-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=staging-1 $no_argo_app --allow-exists --quiet
  render 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/apptique/overlays/staging' 'argo-apptique-staging-1'
  has_unit argo-apptique-staging-1 apptique argo-apptique-base argo-targets/staging-1
  cub unit update --space argo-apptique-staging-1 apptique render/argo-apptique-staging-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/apptique/overlays/staging renders for staging-1' --quiet
  holds argo-apptique-staging-1 1
fi
if handed_over && released argo-apptique-prod-1; then echo '  argo-apptique-prod-1 is released and handed over: ConfigHub holds it, so it is left as it is'; else
  cub variant create prod-1 argo-apptique-base --stage primary --space-pattern template:argo-apptique-prod-1 --target argo-targets/prod-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=prod-1 $no_argo_app --allow-exists --quiet
  render 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/apptique/overlays/prod' 'argo-apptique-prod-1'
  has_unit argo-apptique-prod-1 apptique argo-apptique-base argo-targets/prod-1
  cub unit update --space argo-apptique-prod-1 apptique render/argo-apptique-prod-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/apptique/overlays/prod renders for prod-1' --quiet
  holds argo-apptique-prod-1 1
fi
if handed_over && released argo-checkout-cache-dev-1; then echo '  argo-checkout-cache-dev-1 is released and handed over: ConfigHub holds it, so it is left as it is'; else
  cub variant create dev-1 argo-checkout-cache-base --stage canary --space-pattern template:argo-checkout-cache-dev-1 --target argo-targets/dev-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=dev-1 $no_argo_app --allow-exists --quiet
  render 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/checkout-cache/overlays/dev' 'argo-checkout-cache-dev-1'
  has_unit argo-checkout-cache-dev-1 checkout-cache argo-checkout-cache-base argo-targets/dev-1
  cub unit update --space argo-checkout-cache-dev-1 checkout-cache render/argo-checkout-cache-dev-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/checkout-cache/overlays/dev renders for dev-1' --quiet
  holds argo-checkout-cache-dev-1 1
fi
if handed_over && released argo-checkout-cache-staging-1; then echo '  argo-checkout-cache-staging-1 is released and handed over: ConfigHub holds it, so it is left as it is'; else
  cub variant create staging-1 argo-checkout-cache-base --stage secondary --space-pattern template:argo-checkout-cache-staging-1 --target argo-targets/staging-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=staging-1 $no_argo_app --allow-exists --quiet
  render 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/checkout-cache/overlays/staging' 'argo-checkout-cache-staging-1'
  has_unit argo-checkout-cache-staging-1 checkout-cache argo-checkout-cache-base argo-targets/staging-1
  cub unit update --space argo-checkout-cache-staging-1 checkout-cache render/argo-checkout-cache-staging-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/checkout-cache/overlays/staging renders for staging-1' --quiet
  holds argo-checkout-cache-staging-1 1
fi
if handed_over && released argo-checkout-cache-prod-1; then echo '  argo-checkout-cache-prod-1 is released and handed over: ConfigHub holds it, so it is left as it is'; else
  cub variant create prod-1 argo-checkout-cache-base --stage primary --space-pattern template:argo-checkout-cache-prod-1 --target argo-targets/prod-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=prod-1 $no_argo_app --allow-exists --quiet
  render 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/checkout-cache/overlays/prod' 'argo-checkout-cache-prod-1'
  has_unit argo-checkout-cache-prod-1 checkout-cache argo-checkout-cache-base argo-targets/prod-1
  cub unit update --space argo-checkout-cache-prod-1 checkout-cache render/argo-checkout-cache-prod-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/checkout-cache/overlays/prod renders for prod-1' --quiet
  holds argo-checkout-cache-prod-1 1
fi
if handed_over && released argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-dev-1; then echo '  argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-dev-1 is released and handed over: ConfigHub holds it, so it is left as it is'; else
  cub variant create dev-1 argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-base --stage canary --space-pattern template:argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-dev-1 --target argo-targets/dev-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=dev-1 $no_argo_app --allow-exists --quiet
  render 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/platform/cluster-baseline/overlays/dev' 'argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-dev-1'
  has_unit argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-dev-1 platform-addons-cluster-baseline argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-base argo-targets/dev-1
  cub unit update --space argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-dev-1 platform-addons-cluster-baseline render/argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-dev-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/platform/cluster-baseline/overlays/dev renders for dev-1' --quiet
  holds argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-dev-1 1
fi
if handed_over && released argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-staging-1; then echo '  argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-staging-1 is released and handed over: ConfigHub holds it, so it is left as it is'; else
  cub variant create staging-1 argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-base --stage secondary --space-pattern template:argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-staging-1 --target argo-targets/staging-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=staging-1 $no_argo_app --allow-exists --quiet
  render 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/platform/cluster-baseline/overlays/staging' 'argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-staging-1'
  has_unit argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-staging-1 platform-addons-cluster-baseline argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-base argo-targets/staging-1
  cub unit update --space argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-staging-1 platform-addons-cluster-baseline render/argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-staging-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/platform/cluster-baseline/overlays/staging renders for staging-1' --quiet
  holds argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-staging-1 1
fi
if handed_over && released argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-prod-1; then echo '  argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-prod-1 is released and handed over: ConfigHub holds it, so it is left as it is'; else
  cub variant create prod-1 argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-base --stage primary --space-pattern template:argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-prod-1 --target argo-targets/prod-1 --space-label Role=deployment --space-label Cluster=prod-1 $no_argo_app --allow-exists --quiet
  render 'gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/platform/cluster-baseline/overlays/prod' 'argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-prod-1'
  has_unit argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-prod-1 platform-addons-cluster-baseline argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-base argo-targets/prod-1
  cub unit update --space argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-prod-1 platform-addons-cluster-baseline render/argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-prod-1.yaml --change-desc 'What gitops/argo/expert-app-of-apps/apps/platform/cluster-baseline/overlays/prod renders for prod-1' --quiet
  holds argo-platform-addons-cluster-baseline-prod-1 1
fi

step "5/5 Release each variant, stage by stage: promote, approve, publish"
if handed_over; then
  if released argo-apptique-dev-1; then
    up=$(cub unit get --space argo-apptique-dev-1 apptique -o jq=.Unit.UpstreamRevisionNum)
    cmp -s <(cub revision data --space argo-apptique-base apptique "$up") <(cub unit data --space argo-apptique-base apptique) || { echo 'argo-apptique-base holds a change argo-apptique-dev-1 has not taken. A joining cluster'\''s first release goes through every stage, so this run would promote that change into dev-1 and approve it. Finish that change, or undo it in the base, then run this again.' >&2; exit 1; }
  fi
  if released argo-apptique-staging-1; then
    up=$(cub unit get --space argo-apptique-staging-1 apptique -o jq=.Unit.UpstreamRevisionNum)
    cmp -s <(cub revision data --space argo-apptique-base apptique "$up") <(cub unit data --space argo-apptique-base apptique) || { echo 'argo-apptique-base holds a change argo-apptique-staging-1 has not taken. A joining cluster'\''s first release goes through every stage, so this run would promote that change into staging-1 and approve it. Finish that change, or undo it in the base, then run this again.' >&2; exit 1; }
  fi
  if released argo-apptique-prod-1; then
    up=$(cub unit get --space argo-apptique-prod-1 apptique -o jq=.Unit.UpstreamRevisionNum)
    cmp -s <(cub revision data --space argo-apptique-base apptique "$up") <(cub unit data --space argo-apptique-base apptique) || { echo 'argo-apptique-base holds a change argo-apptique-prod-1 has not taken. A joining cluster'\''s first release goes through every stage, so this run would promote that change into prod-1 and approve it. Finish that change, or undo it in the base, then run this again.' >&2; exit 1; }
  fi
fi
cub changeorder create --space argo-apptique-base onboard-70d46caa --change-workflow argo-apptique-base/rollout --description 'First release of argo-apptique-dev-1, argo-apptique-staging-1, argo-apptique-prod-1' --allow-exists --quiet
if rolled_out argo-apptique-base/onboard-70d46caa; then
  echo 'apptique: every variant in this plan is released'
else
  promote argo-apptique-base/onboard-70d46caa canary
  cub variant approve --change-order argo-apptique-base/onboard-70d46caa --stage canary --quiet
  publish argo-apptique-dev-1 argo-apptique-base/onboard-70d46caa 1
  promote argo-apptique-base/onboard-70d46caa secondary
  cub variant approve --change-order argo-apptique-base/onboard-70d46caa --stage secondary --quiet
  publish argo-apptique-staging-1 argo-apptique-base/onboard-70d46caa 1
  promote argo-apptique-base/onboard-70d46caa primary
  cub variant approve --change-order argo-apptique-base/onboard-70d46caa --stage primary --quiet
  publish argo-apptique-prod-1 argo-apptique-base/onboard-70d46caa 1
fi
if handed_over; then
  if released argo-checkout-cache-dev-1; then
    up=$(cub unit get --space argo-checkout-cache-dev-1 checkout-cache -o jq=.Unit.UpstreamRevisionNum)
    cmp -s <(cub revision data --space argo-checkout-cache-base checkout-cache "$up") <(cub unit data --space argo-checkout-cache-base checkout-cache) || { echo 'argo-checkout-cache-base holds a change argo-checkout-cache-dev-1 has not taken. A joining cluster'\''s first release goes through every stage, so this run would promote that change into dev-1 and approve it. Finish that change, or undo it in the base, then run this again.' >&2; exit 1; }
  fi
  if released argo-checkout-cache-staging-1; then
    up=$(cub unit get --space argo-checkout-cache-staging-1 checkout-cache -o jq=.Unit.UpstreamRevisionNum)

  fi

Finish that change, or undo it in the base, then run this again.' >&2; exit 1; }
  fi
fi

  echo 'checkout-cache: every variant in this plan is released'
else
  promote argo-checkout-cache-base/onboard-996c2e5c canary
  cub variant approve --change-order argo-checkout-cache-base/onboard-996c2e5c --stage canary --quiet
  publish argo-checkout-cache-dev-1 argo-checkout-cache-base/onboard-996c2e5c 1
  promote argo-checkout-cache-base/onboard-996c2e5c secondary
  cub variant approve --change-order argo-checkout-cache-base/onboard-996c2e5c --stage secondary --quiet
  publish argo-checkout-cache-staging-1 argo-checkout-cache-base/onboard-996c2e5c 1
  promote argo-checkout-cache-base/onboard-996c2e5c primary
  cub variant approve --change-order argo-checkout-cache-base/onboard-996c2e5c --stage primary --quiet
  publish argo-checkout-cache-prod-1 argo-checkout-cache-base/onboard-996c2e5c 1
fi
